statement: SELECT row_to_json(x)::text FROM (SELECT current_database() AS database_name, current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS read_only, current_setting('transaction_isolation') AS isolation, txid_current() AS txid, txid_current_snapshot()::text AS snapshot, clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS observed_utc) x
guarantee: one independent RR READ ONLY transaction per observation; before and after are distinct
